battle.name: 沙特阿拉伯統一戰爭
battle.theater: 利雅得盆地與中央高原
battle.brief: 一九〇二年九月九日，伊本·沙特率內吉德戰士夜襲利雅得麥斯馬克堡，奪回內吉德首府，拉開沙特家族統一阿拉伯半島嘅序幕。此後三十年，他先後打敗拉希迪海伊爾埃米爾、迫走漢志謝里夫、收編哈薩同艾錫爾，最後喺一九三二年組成沙特阿拉伯王國。卡面嗰支恩菲爾德步槍，正係雙方陣上嘅主要遠射步槍。

kit.name: 恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 恩菲爾德步槍是英國陸軍的制式栓動後膛步槍，列為標準步兵武器，負責中遠距程射擊，並構成19世紀末至20世紀初英軍步兵裝備體系的核心。

countries: 呢場統一戰爭唔係一次過打完嘅一場戰役，而係由一九〇二年一路延續到一九三二年嘅三十年過程，交戰方亦隨住時勢此消彼長。沙特一方嘅核心係阿爾·沙特家族主持嘅第二沙特國家：一八九一年拉希迪聯盟攻陷利雅得之後，伊本·沙特流亡喺科威特，一九〇一年以數十人喺利雅得奪權，一九〇二年守住利雅得之後重建國家。軍隊骨幹係內吉德部落兵，之後加入「伊赫萬」——一八九九年接受瓦哈比派信仰嘅部落聯盟，專門用嚟對付拉希迪同哈德拉毛勢力，人數一度以萬計，日後亦反過來成為伊本·沙特自己嘅政敵。拉希迪一方係海伊爾城嘅阿爾·拉希迪家族，自十八世紀起雄踞內吉德北部，十九世紀末先後控制利雅得同哈伊爾，君主為穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒·阿扎伊德·拉希迪。鄂圖曼帝國名義上仍係阿拉伯嘅宗主，喺海伊爾駐有代表同軍事顧問，派土耳其軍官訓練拉希迪軍，漢志則由傑馬爾帕夏、恩維爾帕夏等土耳其將領治理。一九一六年侯賽因·本·阿里喺英國支援下宣佈漢志獨立，佔領麥加、麥地那同吉達。外來一方係英屬印度政治部同海灣政治代表：一九〇二年英國正式承認拉希迪做海伊爾埃米爾，之後轉撐伊本·沙特，用津貼、軍火同情報維持兩邊互相消耗，呢個做法喺英方內部叫做「桑德森政策」；科威特、卡塔爾、海灣各酋長國亦喺內地周旋，時而附一邊、時而兩邊都賣人情。
countriesEn: This unification war was not a single campaign but a process that ran from 1902 all the way to 1932, and the list of belligerents shifted as the balance of power changed. On the Saudi side the core was the Second Saudi State ruled by the Al Saud house: after the Rashidi coalition took Riyadh in 1891 Abdulaziz was exiled in Kuwait, seized Riyadh in 1901 with a handful of men, and rebuilt his state after holding the city in September 1902. The backbone of his army was Najdi tribal fighters, later joined by the Ikhwan, a tribal alliance that accepted Wahhabi teaching from 1899 onward and was used against the Rashidis and against the Hashimite zone of eastern Arabia, numbering in the tens of thousands at its height and later turning into the state's own opponent. On the Rashidi side stood the Al Rashid dynasty of Ha'il, which had ruled northern Najd since the eighteenth century and by the end of the nineteenth century controlled both Riyadh and Ha'il under Muhammad bin Abd al-Aziz Al Rashid. The Ottoman Empire was still the nominal suzerain of Arabia: it kept agents and military advisers at Ha'il, sent Turkish officers to drill the Rashidi army, and governed the Hejaz as a province under generals such as Cemal Pasha and Enver Pasha. In 1916 Husayn bin Ali proclaimed the independence of the Hejaz with British backing, taking Mecca, Medina and Jeddah. The outside party was the British Indian Political Department and its Gulf political officers: in 1902 Britain formally recognised the Rashidi as Emir of Ha'il, then switched its support to Abdulaziz, keeping both sides on the string with subsidies, arms and intelligence in what came to be known within the British service as Sanderson's policy; Kuwait, Qatar and the Gulf emirates all trimmed their own position between the two sides, at one moment backing one camp and at another selling favours to both.
people: 伊本·沙特——全名阿卜杜勒·阿齊茲·本·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·沙特——係全場唯一貫穿始終嘅人：一八九一年被逐出利雅得之後喺科威特流亡，一九〇一年靠突襲奪回利雅得，一九〇二年再破麥斯馬克堡，一九〇六年喺穆萊達擊潰拉希迪主力，一九一三年掃平拉希迪殘部，一九二一年攻下海伊爾，一九二五年迫使漢志的阿里投降，一九三二年完成統一。他嘅四個兒子分別做緊軍政要職：沙烏德以漢志軍總司令身份指揮一九二四至二五年攻漢志嘅戰役，費薩爾隨後接掌軍權，阿卜杜拉守內吉德，圖爾基長期做對外談判代表。對面：拉希迪王朝君主穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒·阿扎伊德，其兄阿卜杜勒·阿齊茲·本·阿卜杜拉·拉希迪（阿卜杜勒·拉希迪）係第二沙特國家末代君主，一九〇六年穆萊達戰敗後退入科威特，一九一三年戰死。漢志方面有謝里夫·侯賽因·本·阿里同其兄哈立德·本·侯賽因，後者以漢志軍統帥身份介入麥加、麥地那戰線，並喺英國默許下保住謝里夫國十年。伊赫萬領袖有蘇勒坦·本·巴吉勒、哈立德·本·盧韋伊等部落酋長，佢哋喺一九三〇年聯同阿卜杜拉·本·沙利姆起兵反對伊本·沙特，兩年後被平定。英方人物有海灣政治代表威廉·莎士比亞、查爾斯·馬爾科姆·契塔姆、印度政治部嘅珀西·科克斯同西克斯，阿拉伯局嘅 T. E. 勞倫斯（阿拉伯的勞倫斯）負責一九一六至一八年協助破壞漢志鐵路；鄂圖曼方面有傑馬爾帕夏同恩維爾·帕夏，其中恩維爾喺一九一六年被派往麥地那圍城。
peopleEn: Ibn Saud, whose full name was Abdulaziz bin Abdul Rahman Al Saud, was the one figure who ran through the whole war: exiled in Kuwait after being driven out of Riyadh in 1891, he retook Riyadh by surprise in 1901, stormed the Masmak fortress in 1902, destroyed the main Rashidi army at Mulayda in 1906, swept up the last Rashidi forces in 1913, took Ha'il in 1921, forced Ali of Mecca to abdicate in 1925 and completed the unification in 1932. His four sons each held key military and political posts: Saud commanded the Hejaz army in the 1924 to 1925 conquest of the Hejaz, Faisal took over the command afterwards, Abdullah held Najd, and Turki long acted as his father's diplomatic negotiator. On the other side stood the Rashidi ruler Muhammad bin Abd al-Aziz Al Rashid and his brother Abdulaziz bin Abd Allah Al Rashid, the last sovereign of the Second Saudi State, who was broken at Mulayda in 1906, fled to Kuwait and was killed in 1913. The Hejaz side had Sharif Husayn bin Ali and his brother Khalid bin al-Husayni, who led the Hejaz army in the Mecca and Medina theatre and, with British acquiescence, kept the sharifate alive for ten years. The Ikhwan leaders included tribal chiefs such as Sultan bin Bajil and Khalid bin Luwai, who rose with Abd Allah bin Salman against Ibn Saud in 1930 and were suppressed two years later. On the British side were the Gulf political officer William Shakespear, Charles Malcolm Cheetham, Percy Cox and Percy Sykes of the Indian Political Department, and T. E. Lawrence, the Arab Bureau's man in the Hejaz, who helped wreck the Hejaz railway between 1916 and 1918; on the Ottoman side were Cemal Pasha and Enver Pasha, the latter being sent to besiege Medina in 1916.
kits: 卡面呢件恩菲爾德步槍，同呢場戰爭嘅關係要分兩層睇。第一層係血統：恩菲爾德係一八五八年定裝嘅 .577/450 前裝騎槍改發射室步槍，之後一八七九年改成馬提尼—亨利式，一八八八年再改做李—恩菲爾德（.303 短彈匣式），一八九五年起把彈匣由八發加到十發，成為史密萊 Mk III。阿拉伯人手上有嘅英造步槍，絕大部分就係呢幾種改型，槍身細長、全槍重約四公斤上下、槍管約七百六十公厘，瞄準具可以刻到一千八百碼以外，實戰有效射程喺六七百米，喺平原地形可以壓住對面步兵綫。流入途徑主要有三條：一係阿拉伯商人經波斯、印度同埃及幾條商路走私入口，一係鄂圖曼軍喺漢志同哈伊爾嘅軍械庫存量，一係一九一六年之後英方以空投同海路大批運入「阿拉伯起義」方。戰術上，阿拉伯戰士鍾意英造嘅「長槍」，把槍托抵喺肩膀甚至髖部作立姿精瞄，一九〇二年夜襲麥斯馬克堡時，靠嘅就係駱駝騎兵突然接近之後用步槍同手槍壓住城頭火網，短卡賓槍只能近身肉搏所以慢慢被淘汰。火力骨架仍然係機槍同砲：英方以維克斯、馬克沁水冷重機槍配山炮，砲車用駱駝馱運，槍彈靠驢隊輸走近百里；鄂圖曼軍用德製 MG 08、毛瑟步槍同哈密迪砲；拉希迪與沙特早期仍保留大量舊式燧發前裝獵槍同土製刀劍，彎刀喺突擊同儀式上一直用到現代。
kitsEn: The Enfield rifle on the card face stands in a two-layer relationship to this war. The first layer is lineage: the Enfield was a .577/450 muzzle-loading rifle converted to a breechloader in 1858, was converted into the Martini-Henry in 1879, and became the .303 short magazine Lee-Enfield in 1888, with the magazine enlarged from eight rounds to ten in 1895 to make the Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk III. Almost every British rifle in Arab hands was one of those conversions: long in the barrel, about four kilograms all told, roughly 760 mm in the barrel, with sights graduated beyond eighteen hundred yards and a practical effective range of six to seven hundred metres, which on flat desert ground kept the opposing infantry line under fire. There were three main channels of supply: Arab traders smuggling them in through the Persian, Indian and Egyptian caravan routes; Ottoman stocks in the Hejaz and at Ha'il; and, after 1916, large deliveries by air drop and by sea to the Arab Revolt. Tactically the Arab fighters prized the British long rifle, bracing the butt against the shoulder or even the hip for a standing shot, and in the night attack on the Masmak in 1902 it was the sudden appearance of camel cavalry followed by rifle and pistol fire that suppressed the fire from the walls, the short carbines being of use only at close quarters. The skeleton of the firepower was still machine guns and artillery: the British supplied Vickers and Maxim water-cooled heavy guns with mountain artillery, guns and limbers carried on camels, ammunition moved on donkey trains over distances of a hundred kilometres; the Ottomans used the German MG 08, Mauser rifles and the howitzer; and the Rashidis and the Saudis at first still kept large numbers of old flintlock hunting guns and home-made blades, the curved jambiya remaining in use in assaults and in ceremony right down to modern times.
tactics: 阿拉伯沙漠嘅戰術同歐洲戰場完全唔同，核心係速度、耐熱同對水源同地形嘅熟悉。突擊同夜襲係最常用嘅一招：伊本·沙特喺利雅得同海伊爾都用同一個辦法——趁拂曉前或者入夜，駱駝隊扮成商隊或者牧人突然出現，接近到守軍措手不及即開火衝門，一九〇二年九月九日嘅麥斯馬克之役就係咁樣，突擊隊入到堡內，砍門、開火、逐房清守軍。分進合擊同一九〇六年嘅穆萊達之役最能體現內吉德戰士嘅打法：拉希迪軍照傳統排成密集步兵方陣加砲兵行軍，推進緩慢；伊本·沙特用少量兵力拖住前鋒，主力由兩翼迂迴到側後，喺一望無際嘅平地上完成包圍，把對方逼入無水之地。游擊同消耗亦係常態：打完即散，退返自己嘅水井同椰棗園，等敵軍因為缺水同缺糧而自行崩潰。圍城同斷糧係對付山城嘅標準手法：塔伊夫係易守難攻嘅山城，攻方封死由麥加方向運糧嘅道路，守軍內部飢荒蔓延、士兵倒戈，最後被迫開城；海伊爾亦係同一套路，攻城砲火加封鎖斷糧令守軍人心散亂。聯盟同代理戰係呢場戰爭嘅大戰略：伊本·沙特一路靠聯盟——先聯拉希迪打奧斯曼同哈德拉毛，再聯伊赫萬打拉希迪，之後借英國嘅力量對付謝里夫，英方情報、津貼同軍火加埋，形成一場長達十年嘅代理人戰爭。技術支援亦逐步升級：一戰期間英方以空投送彈藥、架輕機槍同山炮，另有改裝自福特底盤嘅裝甲車喺沙漠橫行；一九三〇至三一年平定伊赫萬叛亂時，英方飛機亦曾提供轟炸支援，砲兵同航空最終取代咗早年生吞活剝嘅冷兵器戰。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the Arabian desert were completely unlike those of a European battlefield, and their core was speed, endurance in the heat, and intimate knowledge of water and terrain. The surprise attack and the night raid were the most common devices: Ibn Saud used the same method at Riyadh and at Ha'il, driving camel columns forward disguised as caravans or herdsmen so that they appeared suddenly and forced the defenders to open fire before the gates could be forced; that is how the Masmak fell on 9 September 1902, the assault party getting inside, chopping at the doors, firing and clearing the garrison room by room. The split and the envelopment showed Najdi fighting at their best at the Battle of Mulayda in 1906: the Rashidi army formed up in the traditional way, dense infantry blocks with artillery in support, and advanced slowly; Ibn Saud held the leading elements with a small force while the main body swung round the flanks and closed behind, completing the encirclement on an endless plain and driving the enemy into country without water. Raiding and attrition were the standing practice too: strike and disperse, fall back on one's own wells and palm groves, and wait for the enemy to collapse from thirst and hunger. Siege and blockade was the standard answer against a hill town: Taif was all but impregnable, so the besiegers cut the road by which grain came from Mecca, famine spread inside the walls, garrison soldiers deserted, and the town had to open its gates; Ha'il followed the same script, with guns and blockade breaking the garrison's morale. Alliance and proxy war was the great strategy of the whole conflict: Ibn Saud built his position on alliances, first with the Rashidis against the Ottomans and the Hashimites of eastern Arabia, then with the Ikhwan against the Rashidis, then with the British against the Sharif of Mecca, so that British intelligence, subsidies and arms turned the whole thing into a decade-long proxy war. Technical support escalated in step: during the First World War the British air-dropped ammunition, light machine guns and mountain artillery, and Ford-based armoured cars ranged the desert; in 1930 and 1931, when the Ikhwan revolt was suppressed, British aircraft provided bombing support, and artillery and aviation finally replaced the old close combat of blades.
data: 步槍本身嘅數據：.577/450 口徑，馬提尼—亨利式槍管約七百六十公厘，全槍約四公斤，瞄準具刻度至一千八百碼，實戰有效射程約六七百米；李—恩菲爾德 .303 口徑，十發彈匣，同樣槍管長度，槍口初速每秒八百四十米上下，有效射程可到八九百米。戰役數據方面：一九〇二年九月九日麥斯馬克之役，突擊隊規模係數十人至百餘人，守軍人數亦只係數百，雙方傷亡無可靠記載。一九〇一年伊本·沙特重返利雅得時只帶數十人同數支槍。一九〇六年四月穆萊達之役，拉希迪軍兵力估計由數百至二三千不等，沙特軍約數百人，雙方傷亡諸說並存。一九一三年拉希迪戰死。一九二一年海伊爾之役，進攻方兵力估計以千計，攻城用火炮數門，圍城約數月。英方供應方面，一九一六至一八年間運入「阿拉伯起義」方嘅步槍以萬計，多屬恩菲爾德系，機槍數十挺，山炮十數門，另有大筆金錢津貼，具體數目各方檔案唔一致。時間跨度：一九〇二年九月九日開打，一九三二年九月統一完成，前後三十年。總傷亡冇可靠統計，各次戰役數字多為當年歐洲報紙推測，宜當作量級而非精確值。一九三二年完成時版圖涵蓋內吉德、海伊爾、漢志、哈薩、卡提夫同艾錫爾。
dataEn: The rifle's own figures: .577/450 calibre, a Martini-Henry barrel of about 760 mm, a total weight of roughly four kilograms, sights graduated to eighteen hundred yards and a practical effective range of some six to seven hundred metres; the Lee-Enfield in .303 took a ten-round magazine with a barrel of the same length, a muzzle velocity of around 840 metres per second and an effective range of eight or nine hundred metres. On the campaign figures themselves: in the Masmak action of 9 September 1902 the assault party numbered between several dozen and a hundred or more men against a garrison of a few hundred, and there is no reliable record of casualties on either side. When Ibn Saud retook Riyadh in 1901 he brought only several dozen men and a few rifles with him. At the Battle of Mulayda in April 1906 the Rashidi army is estimated at anywhere from a few hundred to two or three thousand men against several hundred Saudis, and losses on both sides are given in conflicting versions. The Rashidi was killed in 1913. In the campaign against Ha'il in 1921 the attacking force is estimated in the thousands with a handful of siege guns and a blockade lasting some months. On British supplies, the rifles shipped to the Arab Revolt between 1916 and 1918 ran into many thousands, mostly of the Enfield family, together with several dozen machine guns, a dozen or more mountain guns and very large sums in money, though the exact figures differ from source to source. On duration: the war opened on 9 September 1902 and the unification was complete in September 1932, thirty years in all. There is no reliable total for casualties; the figures for individual actions are largely guesses published in European newspapers of the day and should be read as orders of magnitude rather than exact values. At the completion of the unification in 1932 the territory covered Najd, Ha'il, the Hejaz, al-Hasa, Qatif and Asir.
cause: 打起上嚟有四條因由。第一，內吉德本身分裂：沙特家族同拉希迪家族都自稱係瓦哈比派創建者阿卜杜勒·阿齊茲·本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜嘅正統後人，爭嘅係一份正統性同一批水井，呢個係宗教爭端亦係資源爭端。第二，被逐出去唔肯認輸：一八九一年拉希迪聯盟攻陷利雅得，伊本·沙特流亡科威特，但佢自認沙特家族係內吉德合法統治者，復國對佢嚟講係天職，亦係教義上嘅要求。第三，外部勢力介入：鄂圖曼帝國喺阿拉伯嘅宗主地位隨住歐洲擴張而受挑戰，英國則唔想俄、法、德嘅影響由埃及同波斯伸入海灣，於是英國先承認拉希迪做海伊爾埃米爾，一九〇二年之後轉撐伊本·沙特，用津貼、軍火同情報維持兩邊互相消耗。第四，部落、宗教同地方勢力嘅重新洗牌：伊赫萬部落在瓦哈比派運動之下團結起來，一八九九年之後成為打拉希迪嘅主力；哈德拉毛各酋長國因為懼怕拉希迪同哈伊爾聯盟而倒向伊本·沙特；漢志的謝里夫·侯賽因則以保衛聖地為旗號，拒絕承認伊本·沙特對朝覲管理權嘅主張，令沙特王權同謝里夫國嘅對立最終演變成一九二四至二五年嗰場戰爭。宗教層面上亦帶住遜尼派對波斯什葉派勢力嘅抵抗意味，瓦哈比派嘅教義正好提供咗動員嘅語言同組織形式，令部落兵可以為一個超越部族嘅目標而戰。
causeEn: Four causes drove the war. First, Najd itself was divided: the Al Saud and the Al Rashid houses both claimed to be the legitimate heirs of the founder of the Wahhabi movement, Abdulaziz bin Abd al-Wahhab, and what they contested was a claim to orthodoxy together with a claim to a share of the wells, so that the dispute was religious and material at once. Second, the man who had been driven out refused to accept it: when the Rashidi coalition took Riyadh in 1891 Abdulaziz was exiled to Kuwait, but he held that the Al Saud were the lawful rulers of Najd, and for him restoration was a duty in conscience as much as a duty of faith. Third, outside powers intervened: the Ottoman suzerainty over Arabia was being challenged by European expansion, while Britain had no wish to see Russian, French or German influence advance into the Gulf from Egypt and Persia, so Britain first recognised the Rashidi as Emir of Ha'il and after 1902 transferred its support to Abdulaziz, keeping both sides on the string with subsidies, arms and intelligence. Fourth, tribes, religion and local power were reshuffled: the Ikhwan pulled together under the Wahhabi movement and after 1899 became the main instrument for breaking the Rashidis; the emirates of the eastern province turned to Abdulaziz out of fear of a Rashidi-Ha'il combination; and Sharif Husayn of Mecca, raising the banner of protecting the holy places, refused to concede any Saudi claim to the custody of the pilgrimage, so that the opposition between the Saudi monarchy and the sharifate finally hardened into the war of 1924 and 1925. At the religious level the movement also carried a Sunni resistance to the Shia power of Persia, and the Wahhabi doctrine supplied both the language and the organisational form of mobilisation, which allowed tribal fighters to fight for a cause that stood above their own clan.
impact: 最大嘅影響係阿拉伯半島上面多咗一個新國家。一九三二年九月王國完成統一，疆域由內吉德高原伸到紅海同波斯灣，全國以瓦哈比派遜尼派立國，首都利雅得，呢個狀態一直維持到今日。第二係改變海灣地權：鄂圖曼帝國喺阿拉伯最後一塊據點漢志被剝走，帝國本身亦喺一九一八年之後崩解；一九三八年沙烏地發現石油，之後半個世紀海灣嘅局勢同列強力量對比被徹底改寫，一九四五年沙特成為聯合國創始會員國，一九七三年石油禁運亦由呢個國策引出。第三係新嘅邊界同仲裁安排：伊本·沙特同英國喺一九二七年就邊界同部落歸屬達成協議，同伊拉克同也門嘅談判亦喺三〇年代展開，今日沙特同伊拉克、科威特、卡塔爾、阿聯酋之間嘅邊界，好多都係當年由英方仲裁或雙方協議確定，後來先由當地談判修訂。第四係宗教同政治身份：伊本·沙特將瓦哈比派同「兩座清真寺及其禁地守護者」身份結合，令沙特國王成為遜尼世界宗教地位最高嘅君主之一，亦為日後同伊朗什葉派嘅競爭埋下伏線。第五係社會重組：三十年間大批部落兵轉為常備軍，奴隸制度逐步廢除，但一九三〇年伊赫萬叛亂顯示新國家對部落社會嘅整合仍然脆弱，軍閥同舊酋長嘅力量亦未完全消化。
impactEn: The greatest consequence was the appearance of a new state on the Arabian peninsula. In September 1932 the kingdom was unified, its territory running from the highlands of Najd to the Red Sea and the Persian Gulf, the nation resting on Wahhabi Sunni Islam with Riyadh as its capital, and this condition has lasted to the present. The second was a reordering of power in the Gulf: the last Ottoman foothold in Arabia, the Hejaz, was taken away, and the empire itself collapsed after 1918; oil was discovered in Saudi Arabia in 1938, after which the balance of power in the Gulf was thoroughly rewritten over the following half century, Saudi Arabia became a founding member of the United Nations in 1945, and the oil embargo of 1973 grew out of that position. The third was a new set of frontiers and arbitrations: the agreements of 1927 between Ibn Saud and Britain settled boundaries and the allegiance of tribes, and negotiations with Iraq and Yemen followed in the 1930s, so that many of the present borders between Saudi Arabia and Iraq, Kuwait, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates were fixed by British arbitration or bilateral agreement at that time and only later revised by local negotiation. The fourth was a religious and political identity: by fusing Wahhabism with the guardianship of the two holy mosques, Ibn Saud turned the Saudi king into one of the highest religious authorities of the Sunni world, and at the same time laid the groundwork for the later contest with Shia Iran. The fifth was social restructuring: over three decades tribal fighters were turned into a standing army and slavery was abolished step by step, but the Ikhwan revolt of 1930 showed that the new state's integration of tribal society remained fragile and that the power of the amirs and the old sheikhs had not been fully absorbed.
result: 結果係沙特家族大獲全勝。一九二一年海伊爾陷落，拉希迪埃米爾國終結，君主穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒·阿扎伊德被捕，家族成員送往開羅軟禁。一九二五年謝里夫·侯賽因退位，漢志併入，伊本·沙特同年獲稱「漢志與內吉德王國之王」，一九二七年改名「內吉德與漢志王國」，一九三〇年再改稱「沙特阿拉伯王國」，一九三二年九月宣稱統一完成，各省劃一歸中央直轄，管治由部落聯盟式轉為由沙烏德同費薩爾兄弟主政嘅內閣體制。一九三〇至三一年伊赫萬叛亂被平定，首領阿卜杜拉·本·沙利姆交付法庭處決。過程亦反映出一套可複製嘅做法：伊本·沙特冇一次過靠大軍碾碎對手，而係逐個擊破聯盟——先用利雅得做根據地，再拉攏哈德拉毛酋長打拉希迪，再用伊赫萬打拉希迪，最後借英國之力對付謝里夫，之後再收拾曾經幫過佢嘅伊赫萬；至於卡面嗰支恩菲爾德步槍，喺呢場長達三十年嘅戰爭入面，始終係最基層嘅武器，步槍決定係城牆同山頭上嘅火力交換，而真正扭轉戰局嘅係砲兵、裝甲車、飛機同埋英國嘅錢，武器可以買到，盟國就要自己去贏。
resultEn: The result was a complete victory for the Al Saud. In 1921 Ha'il fell, the Rashidi Emirate came to an end, the ruler Muhammad bin Abd al-Aziz Al Rashid was taken prisoner and members of the family were sent to Cairo under house arrest. In 1925 Sharif Husayn abdicated and the Hejaz was absorbed; in the same year Ibn Saud was proclaimed King of Hejaz and Nejd, in 1927 the state was renamed the Kingdom of Nejd and Hejaz, in 1930 it became the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and in September 1932 the unification was declared complete, the provinces brought directly under the centre and government reorganised from a tribal confederation into a cabinet system under the brothers Saud and Faisal. The Ikhwan revolt of 1930 and 1931 was put down and its leader Abd Allah bin Salman was handed over to the courts. The course of the war also displays a repeatable method: Ibn Saud never tried to crush his opponents with one great army, but broke their alliances one at a time, first making Riyadh his base, then winning the eastern emirates over to break the Rashidis, then using the Ikhwan against the Rashidis, then borrowing British power against the Sharif of Mecca, and finally settling accounts with the very Ikhwan who had helped him. As for the Enfield rifle on the card face, over those thirty years it remained the weapon of the lowest tier: the rifle decided the exchange of fire on walls and hilltops, while what really turned the war was artillery, armoured cars, aircraft and British money. Weapons can be bought; allies have to be won.
